name: document_review
title: Продолжить проверку документов
summary: Persistent review of an EXPLICIT inventory of documents/parent sections in selected datasets. start uses the current user question as goal and selectors from search provenance. status lists prior reviews; task_id resumes one. read returns exact indexed text with next_cursor (fragment_index, offset); follow every cursor before marking a unit reviewed. record requires unit_id, current expected_revision, source_fingerprint from read, an optional request_id (derived automatically from the unchanged decision when omitted in bound chat), status, note and evidence. Prefer {read_id,span_id} from current_read.quote_spans; choose the excerpt supporting your observation. The server copies its exact source characters. Literal {fragment_id,quote} remains supported and must be exact. dependencies names other reviewed unit IDs whose conclusions were used. Changed source bytes, indexed text or dependency revisions cause needs_recheck. history preserves old revisions. accepted is always false. Coverage is selected indexed text only; never claim a complete project audit or visual inspection.

request_id.description: Optional stable receipt key. Bound chat derives one from the unchanged decision when omitted; an explicit key cannot be reused for different content.

span_id.description: Choose a quote_spans span_id from that read, e.g. q1.

quote.description: Copy a SHORT exact contiguous substring from current_read.text, preferably 10–60 characters. Never paraphrase, join separate lines, change spaces, or quote your own note or another source. A longer exact quote up to 300 characters is allowed.

evidence.description: Prefer references {read_id,span_id} from current_read.quote_spans: choose the source excerpt supporting your note, and the server copies its exact characters with checked offsets. Literal {fragment_id,quote} remains available; it must be exact, never paraphrased.

provenance: Selected original SHA256, indexed unit fingerprints and immutable model conclusion revisions
